html:
website\components\media\figure\load.ts

Media URL matrix + progressive loading for <media-figure>:
Sourcesrc/website\components\media\figure\load.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

resolveMediaSources

Builds the media's CDN URL matrix on init: [poster, webm, mp4] per tier for videos (full size + VIDEO_SCALE'd fallback — the browser walks the list until one resolves, so webm-first means "use webm when it exists, mp4 otherwise"), or the thumb URL for images.

mediaPlaceholder

Inline SVG placeholder — a URL-encoded empty would collapse to the ~300×150 default replaced size under width:auto, so carousel placeholders keep their natural box before any bytes arrive (zero-CLS without shipping a real image).

warmFirstRung

CDN warm ordering — fires a detached fetch of the FIRST ladder rung while the figure is still ~600px outside the viewport. The request itself warms the CDN edge and the browser HTTP cache (decodeImageWASM replays it via force-cache), so the 100px-margin climb starts on a hot rung instead of a cold one. Warms only the entry rung — the climb ascends serially, so warming the top rung early would fight the low rung's fetch for bandwidth and warm a resource that may never publish. Never publishes, never marks loaded — pure network warm.

(module scope)

Thumb → high-res quality ladder. Detached Image probes climb the manifest-proven rungs (q50 → q75 → raw original → uncompressed) — webp first, jpg on 404 (the "if webp exists" check is the request itself, no manifest round-trip); every confirmed tier republishes the same high layer's src, so the painted box upgrades in place and can never tear. The 4096²-pixel budget gates the GPU texture upload only — oversized sources still fetch and decode (the browser owns that memory), so a big file can never pin its card on the blurred thumb. Errors mark loaded anyway — a broken image must not pin the skeleton shimmer forever.

best

Highest confirmed probe — the bitmap handed to the GPU at chain end.

publish

Publishes a confirmed tier into the visible high layer — the probe already holds the bytes. The tier mounts as a NEW img stacked over the painted one (reassigning the live img.src would blank the box while the upgrade re-decodes — the rung blink); the clone mounts empty, paints once its own load fires, and retires every layer underneath in the same task, so the swap is atomic per frame. Re-queries the topmost layer each rung because _updateDom rebuilds the shadow DOM wholesale between steps.

retired

Retires every layer UNDER the successor once it is fully painted AND fully opaque — never at load. Removing mid-fade (or before first paint) leaves a translucent rung over an empty figure box for the transition's remainder: the visible quality-swap blink. transitionend fires at fade completion; the timeout covers reduced-motion/no-transition environments where the event never lands. Index order is recomputed at retire time so a newer layer mounted above is never pruned.

climb

Probes rung i through a detached Image; on confirm the tier paints and the climb continues, stopping when the highest proven quality is reached. A proven-but-dead webp retries once as jpg; a dead jpg just skips to the next rung — the best confirmed tier stays painted.
